gaps.title: Production Approval service composition
gaps.detail: Approval routes require app.state.approval_service_factory, but deployment composition has not been proven end to end.

gaps.title: Graph node creates durable Approval and approval_id interrupt
gaps.detail: Internal bridge fields exist, but orchestration does not yet prove Recipe approval step -> Approval row -> Graph interrupt carrying approval_id.

gaps.title: Production approval effect worker
gaps.detail: Durable effects and processor exist, but no production worker/queue composition has been proven to consume pending effects.

gaps.title: RUNNING effect crash lease and reclaim
gaps.detail: A process crash after effect claim can leave status RUNNING; lease timeout, reclaim ownership and DLQ/escalation semantics remain open.

gaps.title: Production Artifact and Agent effect adapter composition
gaps.detail: Adapters are implemented but runtime injection and exact operational retry behavior have not been exercised in production composition.

gaps.title: Graph restart and stale interrupt E2E
gaps.detail: Need proof that a durable decision survives graph/runtime restart and safely resumes or reports stale without a second human decision.

gaps.title: Changes requested enters revision workflow
gaps.detail: CHANGES_REQUESTED feedback is durable, but automatic Edit/Repair task creation and re-review loop are not implemented.

gaps.title: Multi-approver policy execution
gaps.detail: ANY_ONE/ALL/MIN_N/ROLE_BASED_SEQUENCE are modeled; current execution is only ANY_ONE v1 with one authorized decision.

gaps.title: Non-Artifact approval subject resolvers
gaps.detail: ApprovalType supports creative direction, brand rules, budget, publish, destructive action and custom review, but exact subject snapshot/permission/effect implementations are not open to product UI yet.

gaps.title: Approval notification delivery
gaps.detail: Outbox events exist, but in-product/email approval notification consumer and reminder/escalation UX are not proven.

gaps.title: Browser + PostgreSQL + Agent runtime approval E2E
gaps.detail: Need authorized/unauthorized, exact v3 vs v4, duplicate decision, expiry, restart and effect execution in a real multi-service environment.

gaps.title: Hosted GitHub Actions executed green
gaps.detail: NODE-62 cannot be COMPLETE until hosted CI actually executes migration/test/typecheck/lint/build steps successfully.

gaps.title: Legacy UI direct Graph approval bypass
gaps.detail: Closed: Workspace removed Approve & continue direct resumeAgentRun action; technical interrupts now direct users to Formal Approval governance.

gaps.title: Client-supplied Artifact approver identity
gaps.detail: Closed: legacy ApproveVersionRequest no longer accepts approved_by_id and fail-closes browser direct approval; formal decision actor comes from authenticated request context.
